about.title: About Ananta Infratech
about.intro: Ananta Infratech Solutions Private Limited was incorporated in 2020 with a simple goal: bring professional project management, honest pricing and dependable workmanship to construction in Bihar and beyond.
about.story:
We started as a small contracting team and grew by delivering work that clients could trust. Today we run multiple sites at once, supported by an in-house platform for attendance, payroll, materials, equipment and site diaries, so every decision is backed by real data.

Our approach is simple: plan properly, staff properly, supervise closely and document everything.
about.mission: To deliver safe, durable and well-managed construction projects that improve the communities we work in.
about.vision: To be the most trusted infrastructure and construction partner in eastern India.

services.title: Residential Construction
services.summary: Apartments, row houses, villas and township development built to lasting standards.
services.description: From individual homes to multi-block residential developments, we manage structure, finishing and handover with a focus on durability, ventilation, drainage and comfortable living.

services.title: Commercial Buildings
services.summary: Offices, retail spaces, showrooms and mixed-use buildings delivered for business operations.
services.description: We build commercial spaces that are efficient to run and easy to lease, coordinating MEP, fire-safety and façade work under one project team.

services.title: Infrastructure & Roads
services.summary: Roads, drainage, bridges and public works for government and private authorities.
services.description: Our civil teams deliver road networks, storm-water drains, culverts and public utilities with strict control of gradients, compaction and material quality.

services.title: Industrial Works
services.summary: Warehouses, factory sheds and industrial plant civil works built for heavy use.
services.description: Industrial projects demand heavy-load design, fast programme and tight coordination. We deliver shed structures, foundations and plant civil works on schedule.

services.title: Interior & Finishing
services.summary: Plastering, flooring, painting, tiling and interior finishing for completed structures.
services.description: Our finishing teams handle the detail-heavy final stage of a project: plaster, tiling, painting, carpentry and fixtures with a snag-free handover.

services.title: Skilled Workforce Supply

services.description: We supply trained and verified manpower organised by trade, with attendance, wages and safety records maintained through our site management platform.

safety.title: Safety is never negotiable.
safety.intro: Every Ananta site runs under a documented health, safety and environment (HSE) plan. Our goal is zero preventable incidents, and we measure it daily.

points.title: Daily toolbox talks
points.body: Every shift starts with a short safety briefing covering the day's specific hazards.

points.title: PPE compliance
points.body: Helmets, high-visibility vests, gloves and footwear are mandatory for every person on site.

points.title: Working at height
points.body: Certified scaffolding, harness use and inspected access equipment before work starts.

points.title: Incident reporting
points.body: Near misses and incidents are logged, investigated and shared so the same mistake is not repeated.

points.title: Safety-trained workforce
points.body: Workers are trained for their trade before deployment, with refresher sessions on every project.

points.title: Environment & housekeeping
points.body: Dust control, waste segregation and clean, organised work areas on every site.

faq.question: Which areas do you work in?
faq.answer: Our primary operations are in Patna and across Bihar. We take up projects in other locations based on scope and feasibility.

faq.question: Do you handle government tenders?
faq.answer: Yes. Our civil teams execute public works and road packages under tender, with documented quality control at each stage.

faq.question: Can I get a site-specific estimate?
faq.answer: Yes. Share your drawings, location and requirements through the contact form and our team will prepare a plan and estimate.

faq.question: How do you ensure worker safety?
faq.answer: Every site follows a documented HSE plan with daily toolbox talks, mandatory PPE, working-at-height controls and incident reporting.

faq.question: How can a worker or contractor join?
faq.answer: Register through our careers page. Worker and contractor registration is launching soon. Express interest now to be notified when it opens.

faq.question: Do you provide skilled labour only?
faq.answer: Yes, we also supply verified, trade-wise skilled labour for clients who manage their own projects.
